# References · Mark V · Flight Stabilizers

> Feedback, optimal control, MPC and flying machines.

16 works · difficulty: ★☆☆ accessible · ★★☆ technical · ★★★ research-grade

## Start here

#### ★☆☆ Feedback Systems: An Introduction for Scientists and Engineers (2nd ed.)

Åström & Murray · 2021 · *Princeton University Press (free online)* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Feedback%20Systems%3A%20An%20Introduction%20for%20Scientists%20and%20Engineers%20%282nd%20ed.%29%22)

- **Why:** The feedback textbook.
- **Read:** Ch. on state feedback, PID and frequency response.

#### ★★☆ Underactuated Robotics: Algorithms for Walking, Running, Swimming, Flying, and Manipulation

Russ Tedrake · 2023 · *Course notes, MIT 6.832 (free online)* · course · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Underactuated%20Robotics%3A%20Algorithms%20for%20Walking%2C%20Running%2C%20Swimming%2C%20Flying%2C%20and%20Manipulation%22)

- **Why:** Cart-poles, acrobots and trajectory optimization, with code.
- **Read:** The LQR and trajectory-optimization chapters.

#### ★★☆ Small Unmanned Aircraft: Theory and Practice

Beard & McLain · 2012 · *Princeton University Press* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Small%20Unmanned%20Aircraft%3A%20Theory%20and%20Practice%22)

- **Why:** Quadrotor modelling and successive loop closure.
- **Read:** Ch. 2–6.

## Landmarks

#### ★★★ Dynamic Programming

Richard Bellman · 1957 · *Princeton University Press* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Dynamic%20Programming%22)

- **Why:** Dynamic programming: the principle of optimality.
- **Read:** Ch. 3.

#### ★★★ Contributions to the theory of optimal control

Rudolf Kalman · 1960 · *Boletín de la Sociedad Matemática Mexicana* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Contributions%20to%20the%20theory%20of%20optimal%20control%22)

- **Why:** The paper that introduced LQR and controllability.
- **Read:** The problem formulation.

#### ★★★ The Mathematical Theory of Optimal Processes

Pontryagin et al. · 1962 · *Interscience* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20Mathematical%20Theory%20of%20Optimal%20Processes%22)

- **Why:** The minimum principle, the other half of optimal control.
- **Read:** Ch. 1.

#### ★★★ Constrained model predictive control: Stability and optimality

Mayne, Rawlings, Rao & Scokaert · 2000 · *Automatica* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Constrained%20model%20predictive%20control%3A%20Stability%20and%20optimality%22)

- **Why:** Why MPC is stable: terminal costs and constraint sets.
- **Read:** §1–4.
